It broke my heart, but we continued being good friends anyway, hanging out after school, going to anime cosplays conventions and other geeky stuff. We kinda grew apart after high school and went to different universities. Though we weren't close anymore, we still call each other occasionally and hanging out over the summer holidays. Jess started dating Andy during her senior year, and married him a year after she graduated. As for me, I realized I was gay and have only been in romantic relationships with men since.
